title: Mutual Fund Fragility, Dealer Liquidity Provision, and the Pricing of Municipal Bonds
authors: Yi Li; Maureen O’Hara; Xing Zhou
eligible_reason: Single-date (two-period) DiD around the March 2020 COVID crisis. Treatment intensity is bond-level mutual-fund ownership measured pre-crisis (held_by_mf binary, time-invariant; or continuous mf_share), interacted with crisis (Mar 9-20, 2020) or post_crisis (after Apr 30, 2020). All bonds share the same event date, so there are no unit-specific adoption dates; most columns use the continuous mf_share and bond-characteristic x crisis controls, with rating/sector/type/state/date/issuer FE and two-way clustering by date and cusip. Fails the at-least-two-adoption-cohorts rule.
design_notes: replication_LOZ_code.do: Table 2 reghdfe logvolume held_by_mf##crisis if sample_crisis, absorb(rateid sector type state) vce(cluster date cusip); columns with c.mf_share##crisis and absorb(rateid#date sectorid#date typeid#date issuerid#date); Tables 4-5 same with invchg_w and ys; Tables 6-11 ys ~ c.mf_share##post_crisis with characteristic x post controls.
estimators_reported: two-period DiD with continuous/binary pre-determined exposure (reghdfe)
n_adoption_cohorts_note: One event (COVID crisis) for all bonds.
data_files: replication_LOZ_record.log/.smcl (full output on the real data)
data_files_note: README: main.dta merges MSRB, Mergent, eMAXX and Morningstar; all licensed and not shareable.
priority_note: Not eligible (single event date); data not shipped.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text).
